data.title: Telemetry adapter framework + first-party emitters + language stack starter pack

content.text: ## Context

The calibration program needs producer-side telemetry. Epic 2 (`d2f9-ee1a`, colder-fin-exile) ships the AWS Lambda endpoint, S3 store, and `telemetry-emit.sh` utility. Epic 1 (`b575-ac1c`, swap-maple-flyby) ships the cycle-end arbiter that writes per-finding rulings to the defense store. This epic delivers the producers: a tool-agnostic adapter framework, four first-party emitters, and a 12-adapter starter pack covering every tech stack DSO currently recognizes. Without these producers the S3 bucket stays empty and downstream consumer epics (LAURA `25b5-78e3`, replay-regression-harness `87b1-7fd0`, reporting `e8ac-6a65`) have nothing to read.

Direct user-visible value lands on day 1: host-project operators get a drop-in 12-adapter pattern they can install and immediately query via `query-stats.sh counts --client-id=<theirs>`; DSO plugin maintainers get 4 first-party emitter streams (review_finding, resolver_outcome, arbiter_ruling, review_cycle) for live dso-self calibration analysis.
## Approach

**Adapter framework.** Discovery by pure filename convention at `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry-adapters/<tool_id>.sh` (plugin-shipped) with host-project REPLACE override at `.dso/telemetry-adapters/<tool_id>.sh` (host fully replaces plugin; no inheritance — upgrade burden documented in authoring contract). Edge cases: non-executable host file logs a warning and the plugin runs as fallback; syntax error in host file emits a canonical `adapter_error` event and the plugin does NOT run as fallback; symlinks resolved via `realpath` with cycle detection.
**First-party emitters (4).**

- `dso-llm` reads `reviewer-findings.json`; emits one `review_finding` event per finding; `--key dso-llm:<commit_sha>:<run_id>:<cycle>:<finding_index>` (excludes `github.run_attempt` so reruns of the same commit do NOT emit duplicates — Epic 2's `event-id-map.json` dedup suppresses the second emit).

- `dso-resolver` reads defense-store entries; wired into BOTH local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (`TrackerDefenseStore`) AND CI `review-fix-dispatch.md` (`GitHubPRDefenseStore`); emits `resolver_outcome` events with enum values `fixed | defended_accepted | defended_disputed | deferred_to_followup | dropped_by_arbiter`; uses `--link dso-llm:<commit_sha>:<run_id>:<cycle>:<finding_index>`; missing target emits `link_status=missing, finding_event_id=null` rather than blocking.

- `dso-arbiter` reads defense-store arbiter-ruling sub-schema (pinned in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md` with concrete field names: `arbiter.verdict`, `arbiter.severity_override`, `arbiter.rationale_excerpt`, `arbiter.cycle`, `arbiter.finding_index`); emits `arbiter_ruling` events with the same `--link` pattern. Epic 1's `code-reviewer-arbiter` agent does NOT call `telemetry-emit.sh` inline — this adapter is the sole emitter for arbiter_ruling events (see cross-epic boundary comment on Epic 1).

- `review_cycle` reads `${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/review-cycle-usage.json`; emits one `review_cycle` event per cycle summarizing findings/defenses counts, `review_tier`, `elapsed_ms`, `tokens_used`, `token_cost_usd`.

**12-adapter starter pack.** Python: `ruff`, `mypy`, `bandit`. Ruby/Rails: `rubocop`, `brakeman`. Ruby/Jekyll: `htmlproofer`. Node/TS: `eslint`, `tsc`. Go: `golangci-lint` (regex: `'golangci-lint has version ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'`). Rust: `cargo clippy`, `rustfmt` (regex: `'(rustfmt|clippy)[[:space:]]+([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)'`; clippy invoked as `cargo clippy --version`). Plus `sarif-to-canonical.sh` shared accelerator. Each adapter owns its own `--version` extraction with `"unknown"` fallback (per-adapter, no shared helper).

**sarif-to-canonical accelerator.** Reads minimal SARIF 2.1.0 Result fields: `ruleId`, `message.text`, `level`, `locations[0].physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri`, `region.startLine`. Documented fallbacks:
- Missing `locations` → emit artifact-level finding with `line=0`.
- Structured `message.arguments` (no `message.text`) → serialize `arguments[0]`.
- Missing `level` → two-step lookup: first `runs[].tool.driver.rules[] | select(.id == $ruleId) | .defaultConfiguration.level`, then fall back to `"warning"`.
- `kind` field present without `level` → treat as `"warning"`.

**CI integration.** Each existing static-analysis CI job (ruff, mypy, ShellCheck, ESLint, etc.) appends a "post telemetry" step. Fail-open semantics: in-adapter `|| true` AND workflow `continue-on-error: true`. Paired heartbeat alarm: a daily `query-stats.sh counts --client-id=dso-self --hours=24` check fires an alarm if event volume is zero over the prior 24 hours.

**Adapter authoring contract** at `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-adapter-authoring.md` covers: filename convention; REPLACE semantics + upgrade-burden callout (no inheritance — re-sync workflow documented); edge cases (non-executable, syntax error, symlink); `--key` naming pattern with `run_attempt` exclusion rule; tool_version extraction per-adapter responsibility + `unknown` fallback; fail-open + heartbeat; minimal SARIF subset + documented fallbacks (including the two-step `defaultConfiguration.level` lookup); ordering rule (host REPLACE precedence, deterministic per-tool_id ordering, idempotent re-runs).
## Cross-Epic Coordination

- **Producer-consumer to downstream placeholders** (LAURA `25b5-78e3`, replay-harness `87b1-7fd0`, reporting `e8ac-6a65`): canonical schema (owned by Epic 2) is the contract surface; consumer epics define their read patterns in their own brainstorms.

- **Pending-platform epics** (Java `70d5-37ee`, Terraform `jira-dig-1582`, Jenkins `jira-dig-1583`, .NET `ee22-4785`, Azure DevOps `622a-3955`): each ships its own adapters via the drop-in filename convention. This epic's authoring contract is the reference.
- **SARIF-emitting overlaps** (CodeQL `88d2-6756`, Semgrep `6add-c1fc`): both covered by `sarif-to-canonical` accelerator with documented fallbacks for known edge cases.
- **CI health gate** (`c337-ed61`): fail-open semantics MUST be paired with the zero-volume heartbeat (SC5) to avoid desensitizing CI health signals.
- **Architect tool-validation** (`f06e-9c43`): tool_version extraction logic in this epic's adapters must be updated when `f06e` changes tool invocations; coordination note in authoring contract.
- **Gemini provider** (`f9f8-a15c`): post-telemetry step must execute AFTER LLM review completion in CI workflow ordering.
- **Review severity anchoring** (`jira-dig-2568`): `review_cycle` event captures arbiter-anchored severity (event schema owned by Epic 2).
## Success Criteria

1. **Adapter discovery + REPLACE host override** works end-to-end including documented edge cases. Verifiable by `tests/scripts/test-adapter-discovery.sh` exercising: (a) plugin default invocation, (b) host REPLACE supersedes plugin, (c) non-executable host file logs warning + plugin runs, (d) syntax-error host file emits `adapter_error` and plugin does NOT run, (e) symlinked host file resolved via realpath. Each case asserts the documented outcome.

2. **All 4 first-party emitters** produce canonical events with `--link` cross-event linkage. Dangling `--link` emits `link_status=missing, finding_event_id=null` and does NOT block. Verifiable by running a representative review cycle and confirming via `query-stats.sh counts` that each event type appears with consistent linkage; separately by stubbing a dso-llm failure and asserting dso-resolver emits with `link_status=missing`.

3. **dso-resolver cross-store parity**: wired into BOTH local REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md (TrackerDefenseStore) AND CI `review-fix-dispatch.md` (GitHubPRDefenseStore); produces bit-identical canonical event shapes. Verifiable by `tests/scripts/test-resolver-store-parity.sh` exercising both stores against the same fixture and asserting field-level equality on all emitter-read fields.

4. **12 starter-pack adapters** emit schema-valid `tool_finding` events from representative fixtures with `tool_version` populated or `"unknown"` on extraction failure. `sarif-to-canonical` handles documented SARIF edge cases (missing locations, structured message, missing level via two-step `defaultConfiguration.level` lookup, `kind`-only). Verifiable by `tests/scripts/test-adapters.sh` + `tests/scripts/test-sarif-fallbacks.sh`.

5. **Telemetry adapter failure NEVER fails parent CI tool job**: both in-adapter `|| true` AND workflow `continue-on-error: true` apply. Paired heartbeat alarm fires on zero event volume in prior 24 hours via daily `query-stats.sh counts --client-id=dso-self --hours=24` check. Verifiable by (a) injecting broken adapter and confirming CI exits with tool's own exit code, (b) simulating zero-volume condition and confirming the heartbeat alarm fires.

6. **Adapter authoring contract doc** exists at `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/telemetry-adapter-authoring.md` covering: filename convention; REPLACE upgrade-burden callout + re-sync workflow; edge cases (non-executable, syntax error, symlinks); `--key` naming pattern with run_attempt exclusion rule; tool_version extraction per-adapter responsibility + `unknown` fallback; fail-open + heartbeat; minimal SARIF subset + documented fallbacks; ordering rule (host REPLACE precedence, deterministic per-tool_id ordering, idempotent re-runs). Verifiable by reading the doc and confirming each section is present.

7. **Adapter idempotency**: re-running an adapter against identical input produces exactly one canonical S3 event (Epic 2's event-id-map.json keyed by `--key` enforces dedup). Verifiable by `tests/scripts/test-adapter-idempotency.sh` running a representative adapter twice and asserting exactly one S3 event lands.

8. **dso-arbiter contract pinned** in `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md` with concrete arbiter-ruling sub-schema fields (`arbiter.verdict`, `arbiter.severity_override`, `arbiter.rationale_excerpt`, `arbiter.cycle`, `arbiter.finding_index`). Verifiable by reading the contract doc + `tests/scripts/test-arbiter-contract.sh` loading a fixture defense-store entry and asserting dso-arbiter produces a schema-valid event.

9. **Adoption signal**: `query-stats.sh counts --group-by=stack,tool_id --days=7` reports event volume per (stack, tool_id) pair over the prior 7 days. Verifiable on demand by running the query against the populated S3 bucket and inspecting (a) dso-self emits non-zero events across all 4 emitter types within 24h of merge, and (b) per-stack adapter coverage breakdown.
## Operational Constraints (Architecture-vs-Evidence Audit Remediation, 2026-05-16)
### External-dependency verification at this epic's layer (Probe-6 remediation)
Before the da4e sprint can be marked complete, the four external dependencies inherited from Epic 2 (d2f9-ee1a) are verified live at this epic's layer (not deferred to the upstream link):
| Resource | In-session verification command | Expected |
| AWS credentials available | `aws sts get-caller-identity` | Returns 0; identity matches the configured maintainer principal |
| Epic 2 Lambda endpoint reachable | `curl -sf -X POST "$(grep '^review_telemetry.endpoint_url=' .claude/dso-config.conf | cut -d= -f2)" -d '{"event":"healthcheck"}'` | 2xx response |
| Epic 2 S3 bucket populated and readable | `aws s3 ls "s3://$(grep '^review_telemetry.bucket_name=' .claude/dso-config.conf | cut -d= -f2)/" \| wc -l` | ≥1 |
| DuckDB CLI present | `command -v duckdb && duckdb --version` | Returns 0; version recorded in sprint transcript |
| Heartbeat alarm scheduled | `gh workflow list --json name,state \| jq '[.[] \| select(.name \| test("heartbeat\|telemetry-heartbeat")) \| select(.state == "active")] \| length'` | ≥1 |

| SC9 dogfooding (24h freshness window): non-zero `dso-self` events across all 4 emitter types | `aws s3 ls "s3://$BUCKET/dso-self/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)/" --recursive \| grep -cE 'review_outcome\|review_finding\|telemetry_event\|adapter_event'` (event-type names finalized in preplanning) | ≥4 distinct types |

The sprint cannot declare Phase I complete with any of the six checks failing. Each row's ownership (operator who runs the check) and access (AWS CLI + gh CLI + DuckDB CLI, all available in the sprint environment) is implicit in the verification command. Converts the audit's prose-only external dependencies into structured in-session checks at this epic's layer rather than deferring to Epic 2's link.
## Dependencies
- `depends_on` Epic 2 (`d2f9-ee1a`, colder-fin-exile) — `telemetry-emit.sh`, canonical event schema, S3 bucket, `event-id-map.json` flock protection, `query-stats.sh`
- `depends_on` Epic 1 (`b575-ac1c`, swap-maple-flyby) — arbiter writes per-ruling defense-store entries with pinned sub-schema; resolver outcome enum values
- `relates_to` Epic 3 (`f27a-3c6a`, turbid-maze-tread) — shared `plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry-adapters/` directory convention; bot-comment adapters follow same shape; no blocking dependency
